import json,hashlib,pathlib,re
d=pathlib.Path('products/services/diversified-offers/website-verification')
p=(d/'proposal-corrected.md').read_text()
ev=json.loads((d/'correction-evidence.json').read_text())
msg=re.search(r'```\n(.*?)\n```',p,re.S).group(1).lower()
deliv=p.split('## Deliverable')[1].split('## Acceptance')[0].lower()
ev['checks_v1_note']='v1 no_validity_claim=false was a check defect: it scanned the whole proposal, whose Corrections section quotes the removed phrase. v2 scans only the outgoing message and the Deliverable/Verification sections.'
ev['checks']['no_validity_claim']= ('valid' not in msg) and ('well-formed' not in msg) and ('well-formed' not in deliv) and ('not verifiable by us: html/css validity' in deliv)
ev['checks']['no_gpu_claim_deliverable']=('gpu' not in msg) and ('gpu use' in deliv)
ev['all_pass']=all(v for k,v in ev['checks'].items() if k!='message_words')
ev['proposal_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(p.encode()).hexdigest()
(d/'correction-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(ev,indent=1))
print(json.dumps(ev,indent=1))
